research.name: UI Skills
research.note: Curated registry of agent skills for design engineering, browsable on the web, from a CLI and over MCP, with a playbook of short UI lessons.

effects: curated registry of design engineering agent skills from many authors, served through a CLI and an MCP endpoint
baseline-ui skill: MUST/SHOULD/NEVER constraint list an agent applies to UI code (compositor-only animation, 200ms feedback cap, h-dvh, text-balance)
playbook of one-line UI lessons distilled from the skills (inner radius = outer radius minus padding, 0.96 press scale, 44px touch targets)
